change: S5: HOLD THROUGH PULLBACKS (about 7 x ATR14, ~80pt) AND EXIT IN PROFIT; ONE exit rule on line v2 page v2 (no MIL block), empty S1 rules + 1
basis: S1b, 9 days, tag sline_s1b_*. Cohort = all 137 recorded S1b trades; counterfactual = hold from the same entry until price gives back 7 x ATR14(1m) from the trade's best (else to 13:30Z). Group A = the five largest gains from holding, group C = the five largest losses from holding (the rule's price, cited so it is not hidden). Ranked by the counterfactual's size, not by whether it helps. Each trade treated independently (overlap ignored).

trades.group: A: SHAKEN OUT - exited on a small pullback, the leg went on (the case FOR the rule)
trades.would_have: SHORT from 25037.62; recorded exit 25033.88 after 20 min (+3.75pt, peak 24.6pt). Hindsight counterfactual (NOT a result): holding until price gives back 7x ATR14 from the trade's best would have closed +245.4pt, i.e. $+1,933 vs the record (best 329.9pt, 154 min).
